g.text: 214 NOAA Coral Reef Watch regions, 1986–2024, each counted once whatever its reef area. Degree heating weeks add up heat above the usual summer high over 12 weeks. Heat stress is not coral death.
In 1986 it was just 5 of 214 regions. Each line is one region, each column one year. The brighter, the hotter.
The peaks of 1998, 2010, 2016 and 2024 each followed an El Niño, when the Pacific heats up.
In 2024, four in five reef regions crossed the severe heat line
